source_caption:
🎬 1923 (2022–2025)

1923 follows the powerful and emotional story of the Dutton family as they struggle to protect their Montana ranch during one of the most challenging periods in American history. Set against the backdrop of the early twentieth century, the series explores a world shaped by Prohibition, economic hardship, political corruption, and the growing pressures threatening traditional ranching life. At the center of the story are Jacob Dutton and his wife Cara, who lead the family through dangerous conflicts involving wealthy landowners, ruthless businessmen, and enemies determined to take control of their property. Meanwhile, Spencer Dutton, a World War I veteran living abroad, finds himself drawn into an extraordinary journey involving love, danger, and the responsibility of protecting his family’s legacy. As the Duttons face devastating losses, unexpected betrayals, and increasingly violent confrontations, their determination to preserve the ranch becomes a struggle for survival. The series also explores the experiences of Teonna Rainwater, a young Indigenous woman fighting to escape the brutality of a government-run boarding school. Through breathtaking landscapes, intense family drama, emotional relationships, and powerful historical storytelling, 1923 reveals the sacrifices required to defend a family’s future. Combining Western adventure, gripping action, and unforgettable characters, the series explores loyalty, courage, love, survival, injustice, and the enduring legacy of the Dutton family.

🎭 Genre: Western • Drama • Historical

⭐ IMDb: 8.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 50–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Taylor Sheridan

📺 Where to Watch: Paramount+. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: 1923 is an American neo-Western television series created by Taylor Sheridan that premiered on December 18, 2022, on Paramount+. The series serves as a prequel to Yellowstone (2018–2024), a sequel to 1883 (2021–2022), and is the third television series in the Yellowstone franchise. It stars Helen Mirren, Harrison Ford, Brandon Sklenar, Julia Schlaepfer, Jerome Flynn, Darren Mann, Brian Geraghty, Aminah Nieves, Michelle Randolph, and Timothy Dalton in main roles while Isabel May reprises her role as narrator Elsa Dutton from 1883. The second and final season premiered on February 23, 2025. The series concluded on April 6, 2025, after two seasons consisting of sixteen episodes.
